originalTitle: Senate sets up votes to sanction Russia for Ukraine war
summary: The sanctions target Russian officials, oligarchs, their family members, foreign persons, Russian banks and financial institutions and the Russian shadow fleet.
content:
The Senate late Tuesday agreed to begin voting on a long-awaited sanctions bill aimed at hobbling Russia 's war effort in Ukraine .

The bill, named for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, is a package of sanctions and tariff authority targeting Russian oil sales. Proponents say oil is the top commodity Moscow uses to fund its war machine, and targeting it now will help Kyiv turn the tide on the battlefield.

Sen. Richard Blumenthal , D-Conn, along with Sens. Darline Graham , R-S.C., Katie Britt , R-Ala., Jeanne Shaheen , D-N.H, Roger Wicker , R-Miss., and Jim Risch , R-Idaho, announced on Tuesday they had reached a deal to combine the Russia sanctions package with sanctions on Iran. That move allows a first vote to be expected on Tuesday night, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is in Washington for Graham's funeral services.

"We are proud to announce an agreement on legislation to stop purchasers of Russian oil and gas from fueling Putin's war machine and to continue restricting the Iranian regime's ability to support terrorism and build its nuclear program," the lawmakers said in a joint statement, referring to Russian President Vladimir Putin. "There is no greater way to honor Senator Graham's legacy than to move forward with this bipartisan agreement, and we look forward to today's vote."

Graham had just returned to Washington from Ukraine when he died. A White House whisperer, Graham was crucial in swaying President Donald Trump to continue supporting Ukraine after the president soured on supplying U.S. aid to the country during the beginning of his second term.

The bill includes sweeping sets of sanctions aimed at Russia and the enablers of its war effort.

The sanctions target Russian officials, oligarchs, their family members, foreign persons, Russian banks and financial institutions and the Russian shadow fleet.

The legislation also aims to use one of Trump 's favorite tools by including a new authority for the president to impose tariffs on imported goods from countries that buy Russian oil or enable Russian sanctions evasion. The tariffs would be limited to the top five importers of Russian oil or gas and the top five enablers of energy sanctions evasion.

The bill would also extend sanctions authority that restricts funding for Iran's energy and weapons sectors, a crucial component of getting an agreement while the U.S. continues to wage a war with Iran.
chineseTitle: 参议院投票表决因乌克兰战争而制裁俄罗斯
chineseSummary: 制裁针对的是俄罗斯官员、寡头及其家人、外国人、俄罗斯银行和金融机构以及俄罗斯影子舰队。
chineseContent:
周二晚些时候，参议院同意开始对一项期待已久的制裁法案进行投票，该法案旨在阻碍俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争努力。

该法案以已故南卡罗来纳州参议员林赛·格雷厄姆的名字命名，是针对俄罗斯石油销售的一揽子制裁和关税授权。支持者表示，石油是莫斯科为其战争机器提供资金的首要商品，现在瞄准石油将有助于基辅扭转战场局势。

康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔与南卡罗来纳州共和党参议员达林·格雷厄姆、阿拉巴马州共和党参议员凯蒂·布里特、新罕布什尔州民主党参议员珍妮·沙欣、密西西比州共和党罗杰·威克和爱达荷州共和党参议员吉姆·里什周二宣布，他们已达成一项协议，将俄罗斯制裁方案与对伊朗的制裁结合起来。这一举措预计将在周二晚上进行第一次投票，而乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基正在华盛顿参加格雷厄姆的葬礼。

议员们在一份联合声明中提到俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京时表示：“我们很自豪地宣布达成一项立法协议，以阻止俄罗斯石油和天然气的购买者为普京的战争机器提供燃料，并继续限制伊朗政权支持恐怖主义和制定核计划的能力。” “没有比推进这项两党协议更好的方式来纪念格雷厄姆参议员的遗产了，我们期待着今天的投票。”

格雷厄姆去世时刚刚从乌克兰返回华盛顿。格雷厄姆是白宫的耳语者，在特朗普总统在第二任期之初对美国向乌克兰提供的援助感到不满后，格雷厄姆在说服他继续支持乌克兰方面发挥了关键作用。

该法案包括针对俄罗斯及其战争推动者的一系列全面制裁。

制裁针对的是俄罗斯官员、寡头及其家人、外国人、俄罗斯银行和金融机构以及俄罗斯影子舰队。

该立法还旨在利用特朗普最喜欢的工具之一，即赋予总统一项新的权力，可以对来自购买俄罗斯石油或允许俄罗斯逃避制裁的国家的进口商品征收关税。关税将仅限于俄罗斯石油或天然气的前五名进口商以及逃避能源制裁的前五名推动者。

该法案还将扩大制裁权限，限制对伊朗能源和武器部门的资助，这是在美国继续与伊朗发动战争的情况下达成协议的关键组成部分。
